description: List public archived threads in a channel. Returns thread objects, thread member entries, and a next_before cursor. Page older threads in descending order by archive timestamp using before=next_before. To list private archived threads instead, use discord_list_private_archived_threads. Bot permissions it may need: Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp cursor to return threads archived before this time; page with next_before

channel_id.description: ID of the parent channel containing the public archived threads

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return (2-100)

name: discord_list_public_archived_threads
